options.title: Describe the problem in one sentence, without code
options.body: Step back for a second. Describe the problem in plain English, without any code — what is it actually doing wrong? Often just writing that sentence reveals the fix. If you're stuck, note the last point where things worked and what's changed since.

options.title: Describe the bug in plain English
options.body: Describe the bug in plain English, no code. Often the sentence itself reveals the fix. What was the last point it worked?

options.title: What's actually going wrong?
options.body: What's actually going wrong, in plain words? Often that's the fix.
